sentence_stem: I can't come to the party tonight
correct_completion: because I have to work late.
full_sentence: I can't come to the party tonight because I have to work late.
acceptable_variants: because I have an exam tomorrow.

options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result, and the message gives no reason. Tomorrow also changes the meaning of 'tonight'.
This gives an unrelated fact and does not explain why the speaker cannot come.

options.text: because I have to work late.

options.why_wrong: This describes where the speaker is, not why they cannot come to the party.

explanation: 'Because' introduces the reason for the situation in the first part, so the completion must give a cause. Learners may confuse 'because' with 'so', but 'so' introduces a result.
translation: Nie mogę przyjść na imprezę dziś wieczorem, bo muszę pracować do późna.
